sentences.en: Lyndon Johnson took over presidency when John Kennedy was assassinated.
sentences.zh: 1. 肯尼迪遇刺后，林登·约翰逊接任总统职务。

sentences.en: He made his way to presidency step by step.
sentences.zh: 2. 他一步一步地迈向了总统的宝座。

sentences.en: Ought he to be forced out of the presidency?

senses.zh: 总统（或董事长、会长、大学校长等）的职位（任期）；管辖；支配
